verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs promise data portability: 'import content into your spaces and export it at any time' in 'Markdown or Any-Block' format, plus self-hosting and local-only modes for full data control (anytype-docs-11, anytype-docs-20, anytype-docs-6, anytype-docs-30). However, hands-on community reports contradict smooth open-format portability: one user notes 'I can't just use raw Markdown or CSV file with Anytype' unlike Obsidian, and another calls import/export 'painful,' saying the zip-based export is 'unusable for my own backup purposes,' while another flags that Anytype's open-source claim doesn't match the standard OSD. missing for 10: independent verification that exported Markdown/Any-Block preserves full fidelity, clarity on whether 'Any-Block' is a truly open/interoperable format, and resolution of the OSD licensing dispute.
